answer: An orchard marketplace selling nectar, even to tundra agents, can charge a nonrefundable 10-credit fee per identity per epoch and cap all identity-based rewards at 2 credits. Give one influence ticket per paid fee, with no free account votes or referral bonuses. Each extra compliant identity then loses at least 8 credits; splitting accounts cannot create unpaid influence. Resistance depends on enforcing the reward cap across every subsidy route.
